history.summary: Important Narasimha shrine a few kilometres outside Hazaribagh on Barkagaon Road (Morangi area), ~3-5 km from the city centre. The sanctum houses a Narasimha idol along with a Shivalingam; the complex also holds statues of Vishnu's ten avatars (Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Narsingh, Vamana, Parashurama, Rama, Krishna, Buddha, Kalki) and shrines to Kali and Lakshmi Narayan. The Kartik Purnima fair draws record crowds (covered by local press in 2026 with heavy security deployment). Opening hours conflict across sources (9 AM-1 PM / 3-5 PM vs 5 AM-5 PM) - verify locally. CSV state error: CSV column holds town 'Hazaribagh'; actual state is Jharkhand. Coordinates are the POI-level listing coordinates (23.94828, 85.359718).

name: Narsingh Sthan Temple
town_description: Hazaribagh is a district headquarters city in Jharkhand, about 95 km from Ranchi, set among hills and forests with the popular Hazaribagh Lake. It is a regional hub for the surrounding pilgrimage spots - Narsingh Sthan (~3-5 km on Barkagaon Road), Surajkund hot springs (~32 km) - with hotels, eateries and rail/road links to Ranchi and Koderma.

travel.airport: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi, about 100 km.
travel.railway: Hazaribagh Town railway station, about 3.4 km from the temple.
travel.road: On Barkagaon Road, a few kilometres from Hazaribagh city centre; autos and local buses from the town.

visitor_information.best_time: October to February; Kartik Purnima for the fair if prepared for crowds.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sources conflict: commonly 9:00 AM-1:00 PM and 3:00-5:00 PM; one listing says 5:00 AM-5:00 PM - verify locally.
